judgments.basis: ASC 842-10-25-2(a) to (e) and 842-10-25-3; s1_f_term; s2_f_economic_life; s2_f_fair_value; the 75% and 90% thresholds of 842-10-55-2 used as reasonable approaches to 'major part' and 'substantially all'.
judgments.proposedConclusion: Operating lease. None of the five criteria in ASC 842-10-25-2 is met: title does not transfer, there is no purchase option, the 3-year term (s1_f_term) is 15% of the 20-year remaining economic life (s2_f_economic_life) and not a major part, the present value of the payments (328,710.16 USD) is 16% of the 2,000,000.00 USD fair value (s2_f_fair_value) and not substantially all, and general-purpose office space is not specialized.
judgments.question: Is lease OFF-001 a finance lease or an operating lease under ASC 842-10-25-2?

judgments.proposedConclusion: The 6.00% incremental borrowing rate (s3_f_rate): the rate implicit in the lease is not readily determinable, and the collateralized 3-year borrowing rate for a similar amount and term is the ASC 842-20-30-3 rate.
